LESSON OBJECTIVE
Identify complementary angles and solve missing-angle problems, including algebraic and right-triangle cases.
CORE IDEA
Two angles are complementary when their measures add to 90 degrees. They need not be adjacent, but when adjacent they form a right angle.
KEY DEFINITIONS
Complementary angles: angles whose measures sum to 90°. Right angle: an angle measuring 90°. Acute angle: an angle strictly between 0° and 90°.
CORE RULE
If angles a and b are complementary, a+b=90°. Therefore b=90°−a. For algebraic expressions, set their sum equal to 90° and solve.
HOW IT WORKS
Identify the two angles; add their measures; set the sum to 90°; solve any equation; substitute back and check that both measures are positive and sum to 90°.
WORKED EXAMPLE 1 — BASIC
If one angle is 30°, the other is 90°−30°=60°. Check: 30°+60°=90°.
WORKED EXAMPLE 2 — ALGEBRA
If angles are x° and 2x°, then 3x=90, so x=30. The angles are 30° and 60°.
WORKED EXAMPLE 3 — EXPRESSIONS
For (3x+12)° and (x+18)°, solve 4x+30=90 to obtain x=15. The angles are 57° and 33°.
WORKED EXAMPLE 4 — RATIO
For complementary angles in ratio 2:3, write 2k+3k=90. Then k=18 and the angles are 36° and 54°.
WORKED EXAMPLE 5 — WORD PROBLEM
One angle is 7° larger than its complement. If smaller=s, then s+(s+7)=90; 2s=83 and s=41.5°.
WORKED EXAMPLE 6 — RIGHT TRIANGLE
The two acute angles in a right triangle are complementary because all triangle angles total 180° and the right angle uses 90°. For 3x+5 and x+9, x=19; angles are 62° and 28°.
COMMON MISTAKES
Complementary means sum 90°, not 180°. The angles do not have to be touching. Do not assume they are equal; equal complementary angles are both 45°.
EXAM STRATEGY
Spot the words complementary or right triangle. Write one equation totaling 90° before simplifying. For ratios, use a common multiplier. Check both resulting angles.
QUICK CHECK
Q1: Complement of 65° is 25°. Q2: Angles 2x and x imply x=30°. Q3: A 37.5° angle has a 52.5° complement.
LESSON RECAP
Complementary angles total 90°. Subtract from 90 for a missing angle or solve a sum equation when expressions are given.
